title: POSITRACTION
summary: CANCELED sheet. Positraction rear axle option (RPO G81): the Positraction differential carrier assembly, an identification tag on the carrier, and a caution sticker (with the auto jack instruction tag) glued inside the jack stowage compartment cover behind the seats. Rear axle and transmission are covered under UPC 4A and 7B.
